f_road.title: Draw a road from the Founding Stake
f_road.hint: Roads tab, then drag a Dirt Track. Everything grows beside a road.

f_hearth.title: Zone hearths beside the road
f_hearth.hint: Zones tab, Hearth, drag a rectangle touching the road.

f_jobs.title: Zone Craft works and a Market
f_jobs.hint: Folk need jobs; markets need goods from the works.

f_spire.title: Raise a Ley Spire within 6 tiles of the node
f_spire.hint: Ley tab. A lit spire lights 5 tiles; lit buildings light their neighbours.

f_well.title: Dig a Well
f_well.hint: Water tab. Wells water 8 tiles, more near the river.

f_watch.title: Build a Watch Post and a Shrine of Aume
f_watch.hint: Services tab. The Watch calms unrest; the shrine lifts hearts.

f_sector.title: Extend the Charter
f_sector.hint: Click the dimmed land beyond the Charter line: from Hamlet a touching sector can be bought, and the Gloam inside draws back.

f_hamlet.title: Reach 40 folk: a Hamlet
f_hamlet.hint: Keep zoning where the demand bars are high.

l_all.title: Light every building
l_all.hint: Mana view (1) shows unlit buildings in red. Chain spires within 6 tiles of each other.

l_water.title: Water every building
l_water.hint: Water view (2). Dry homes lose folk after two weeks.

l_nexus.title: Build a Ley Nexus
l_nexus.hint: Stores 120 mana to soak up peaks before they become surges.

l_font.title: Raise a Thrum Font
l_font.hint: A bored well into a deep Vein: +40 mana anywhere.

l_deepen.title: Deepen the Wellspring
l_deepen.hint: Click the founding node; from Burgh it can be deepened for +45 mana.

d_boneyard.title: Build a Boneyard before the dead rise
d_boneyard.hint: Unquieted dead become the restless. Services tab.

d_restless.title: Lay a restless to rest
d_restless.hint: Watch coverage (6) and wards clear them; wisps show where they are.

d_ossuary.title: Build an Ossuary
d_ossuary.hint: Quiets 40 dead a day within 20 tiles.

g_ward.title: Raise a Ward Lantern
g_ward.hint: Burns back the Gloam within 10 tiles. Needs mana.

g_burn.title: Burn back 50 tiles of Gloam
g_burn.hint: Wards and Gloam view (g) show the grey and what holds it.

g_wall.title: Draw 20 tiles of Warding Wall
g_wall.hint: Services tab. The Gloam and its hounds never cross it.

g_hounds.title: Kill 10 Gloam-hounds
g_hounds.hint: A Hunters' Lodge hunts within 12 tiles each night.

g_gate.title: Raise a gate of the Pass
g_gate.hint: A Belregi or Uzulim gate lets roads through the wall and wards the ground around it.

g_greatgate.title: Raise the Great Gate
g_greatgate.hint: A wonder of the Burgh: the gatehouse of the Pass, raised in the angle between a Belregi gate and its road (a corner counts). Lit, it wards 20 tiles, every Belregi gate reaches 12, and pilgrims of the Pass come each season.

g_heart.title: Answer the High Warden of Belregi
g_heart.hint: Ten days after the Great Gate stands lit, the High Warden brings the Heart of Belregi. What she has heard of your gates (the pilgrims, the Lantern Fair, the poachers, Belregi against Uzulim) colours the tale; in the Hush the Heart wakes.

o_cart.title: See the first cart deliver
o_cart.hint: Donkey carts carry potions from the works to the markets by road. Show me finds one on the way.

o_full.title: No market short for five days
o_full.hint: Goods view (o). Zone works near the markets, or build a Trade Depot and import.

o_depot.title: Build a Trade Depot
o_depot.hint: Sells surplus goods at seasonal prices; caravans stop there.

o_caravan.title: Sell 200 goods to a Belerial caravan
o_caravan.hint: A caravan halts at the depot every 12 days (the depot panel counts them down); choose Trade to sell every works' surplus above 10 goods. Works fill when the markets are already stocked.

a_academy.title: Educate a third of the folk
a_academy.hint: An Academy of the Ley schools within 14 tiles.

a_arcane.title: Grow the first Arcane building
a_arcane.hint: Arcane zones need schooling coverage to grow.

a_mine.title: Dig a Crystal Mine
a_mine.hint: Must be dug into hills; roads may cut through hills.

a_artifact.title: Sell the first artifacts
a_artifact.hint: Enchanters need leystone carted from a mine.

x_paint.title: Paint a district
x_paint.hint: Districts tab (from the Hamlet). Drag a rectangle over part of the city; a district is a place you can charter and rule apart.

x_charter.title: Charter a district
x_charter.hint: Edicts panel: pick the district in Scope and choose a charter. A Craft quarter makes a fifth more goods; a Hearth quarter is worth more to live in; each has a price.

x_pay.title: See the charter pay
x_pay.hint: Two days under a charter: watch the works, the shelves or the land value move in the district view (i).

x_edict.title: Set an edict for a district
x_edict.hint: Edicts panel, choose the district in Scope.

s_brownout.title: Ride out a brownout
s_brownout.hint: When demand passes the flow the spires flicker; cut consumers or add flow before the fifth day and no surge comes.

x_rename.title: Name a district
x_rename.hint: Edicts panel: pick the district in Scope and type a name.

s_vigil.title: Keep the Hush vigil
s_vigil.hint: On the first night of the Hush the city is asked to keep every window lit.

s_feast.title: Hold a Thaw feast
s_feast.hint: On Thaw-day of the second year, pay for the feast.

b_moths.title: See glimmoths at the node
b_moths.hint: They swarm lit ley at night. Zoom in on a spire after dusk.

b_wisps.title: Glimpse a wisp ring
b_wisps.hint: Six or more wisps at once over a boneyard mean the dead are restless there.

s_hush.title: Survive a Hush
s_hush.hint: Long nights: hearths drink more mana, the Gloam grows bold, hounds hunt.

b_loft.title: Build a Moth-Loft
b_loft.hint: Glimmoths swarm lit ley at night; a loft near it gathers glim-dust for the works.

w_cradle.title: Raise a Wyrm-Cradle and a Tamer's Lodge
w_cradle.hint: Cradle near a spire (it must be lit); lodge within 10 tiles.

w_egg.title: Accept an egg
w_egg.hint: The Crown sends one to your first cradle; more come from mines, boneyards, lofts and poachers.

w_hatch.title: Hatch it
w_hatch.hint: Keep the cradle lit for 30 days. Then feed it from nearby markets.

w_role.title: Give a drake a role
w_role.hint: Wyrms panel: warden of a district or delver at a mine.

w_courier.title: Fly goods with a wyvern courier
w_courier.hint: Ember, vein, sky and storm lines grow wings.

w_ring.title: Win a bout in the Wyrm-Ring
w_ring.hint: Build the Ring (Market Town) and name a champion; bouts are on day 15 of each season.

k_mill.title: Raise a Torrent Mill
k_mill.hint: Ley tab, Township. On the riverbank, touching water and a road: 30 mana a day from falling water.

k_glim.title: Keep the works warm with a Glimhouse
k_glim.hint: Services tab. Craft works within 8 ignore the Hush and make 10% more.

k_gardens.title: Plant Hanging Gardens against the hills
k_gardens.hint: Services tab, Township. Goods, health and light with no mana; unlocks the Glowvine Lane.

k_glowvine.title: Lay 12 tiles of Glowvine Lane
k_glowvine.hint: Roads tab. Lit by the vines within 12 tiles of a Hanging Gardens, no mana.

k_obs.title: Raise an Astral Observatory
k_obs.hint: Services tab, Market Town. The week ahead appears in the Ledger.

p_arch.title: Raise a pair of Portal Arches
p_arch.hint: Ley tab, Market Town. Both lit, 12 mana each; carts step from one to the other.

r_delve.title: Dig at the Ruins of Lukuku
r_delve.hint: Flagstones in a forest, somewhere on the map. A Ruin Delve there brings up relics.

t_plant.title: Plant the World Tree Sapling
t_plant.hint: Leisure tab, Free City. Twenty thousand crowns and three seasons of patience.

t_grown.title: See the World Tree full-grown
t_grown.hint: Three seasons after planting its shade reaches 24 tiles.

e_foundry.title: Bind a Concord Warden
e_foundry.hint: Mines wake them in the hills. A Golem Foundry (Burgh) within 12 tiles binds them into labour.

e_beacon.title: Keep a school of skyrays
e_beacon.hint: Ley tab, Burgh. A lit Ley Beacon turns a passing school in Bloom or Ember.

e_mews.title: Stable Watch drakes
e_mews.hint: Services tab, Burgh. A Drake Mews doubles the reach of every Watch House.

e_edict.title: Set a taming edict
e_edict.hint: Edicts panel: Beastmasters' Charter, Hunters' Bounty or Wyrm-Peace.

q_quay.title: Send a barge between two Quays
q_quay.hint: Services tab, Village. Two quays on the same river or lake, works near one and markets near the other.

q_float.title: See a floating cart
q_float.hint: An Arcane workshop at level 3 sends two hovering carts onto the roads.

q_rider.title: A drake rider lays a restless down
q_rider.hint: Riders fly out from a lit Drake Mews to the restless and to fires.

q_airship.title: Launch the airship
q_airship.hint: Leisure tab, Beacon of Eda: the Sky-Dock. The ship leaves on day 3 of each season with your surplus.

w_meat.title: Put game on a market's shelves
w_meat.hint: A Hunters' Lodge's panel names its quarry: choose the deer or the boar in its grounds, with a market within 16. The hearths within 10 of that market are happier.

w_fish.title: Put fish on a market's shelves
w_fish.hint: Water tab: a Fishers' Hut touching river or lake water, a market within 12. Fish spoil in two days; the hearths within 10 of that market are happier.

w_thatch.title: Thatch ten homes
w_thatch.hint: Water tab: Reed-Cutters' Hut on the shore. It thatches the level-1 homes within 10: +3 happiness, but thatch burns.

w_wyrm.title: Clear the bridge
w_wyrm.hint: In Bloom a marsh-wyrm may lair under a bridge, and the carts crawl. A Veshari Hall whose reach covers the bridge drives it off; none lairs within 10 of a Quay.

w_ford.title: Ford the river
w_ford.hint: A Dirt Track over a narrow river is a ford: a third of a bridge's price, but under water in the Thaw's first ten days (a Weir within 6 holds it).

n_tiger.title: Bring down a war-tiger
n_tiger.hint: Hunters' Lodges within 12, Watch Houses at full strength, or a warden drake's district.

n_font.title: Raise the Font of Quieting
n_font.hint: Services tab, Free City. Deathcare +50% and the restless lie down easily.

n_storm.title: Dissolve a mana-storm with wards
n_storm.hint: After a surge a storm drifts; ward coverage over its eye ends it.

y_attune.title: Attune a cradle to its node
y_attune.hint: Click a node to see its aspect; a cradle within 10 tiles grows matching eggs a quarter faster.

y_marvel.title: Raise a Marvel
y_marvel.hint: The Marvels tab spends scale, wyrmfire, eggshell, rayscale and glim-dust on buildings no crowns can buy.

y_quiet.title: Keep the Gloam quiet through a Hush
y_quiet.hint: Pressure below 45% on every day of a Hush: deathcare, faith coverage and Grey ley.

k_council.title: Seat the guild council
k_council.hint: A lit Guildhall (Leisure tab) seats the four guilds. Every 20 days the least pleased of them petitions for an edict.

k_boon.title: Please a guild
k_boon.hint: Raise one guild's standing to 70 (Edicts panel shows what moves each). A pleased guild pays a boon: more exports, more goods, deeper stores or quieter dead.

k_feast.title: Feed a Thaw feast from the shelves
k_feast.hint: On the second day of Thaw the feast takes 40 goods from the markets; every district whose markets fed it is happier for a season.

k_twinroad.title: Open the Twin Road
k_twinroad.hint: A Trade Depot within 12 tiles of the daughter's stake and another in the mother city: 30 goods a day cross, and the Crown pays a toll.

k_hall.title: Earn a guild hall
k_hall.hint: Keep one guild at 70 or better for ten days and it raises its own hall by the Guildhall: a yard, a lyceum, a lodge or a chapel.

k_cross.title: Breed a crossed egg
k_cross.hint: Two drakes of different lines, content, in a lit cradle attuned to one of them: on Bloom day 20 they lay an egg that carries both auras. Needs a free cradle slot.

k_relics.title: Complete a relic set
k_relics.hint: Every twelfth relic from the Ruin Delve is a piece of a set; an Academy catalogues one a day. Three pieces make a set and a lasting boon.

k_blood.title: Begin a bloodline
k_blood.hint: Two crossed dragons, content in a lit attuned cradle, lay a trueblood egg: both auras in full, faster growth, half again the scale.

k_relicbuild.title: Raise a relic building
k_relicbuild.hint: Each complete relic set unlocks a building in the Marvels tab: a lantern, a hall, a font or a chart-room.

k_wyrm.title: Raise a great wyrm
k_wyrm.hint: A trueblood wyvern grows on to the wyrm stage: auras half again as wide, the Gloam shrinks from it, and it eats 20 goods a day.

k_assessor.title: Sell relics to the Crown
k_assessor.hint: The depot sells two loose relics a day once the camp holds more than ten; the Crown's assessor pays more in person.

k_charter.title: Charter a rivalry away
k_charter.hint: In the Edicts panel a 2,000-crown charter ends a rivalry for good: no more drag, sting or brawls between the pair.

k_duel.title: A great wyrm meets the Vein-Wyrm
k_duel.hint: When a great wyrm stands in a cradle, a hostile flyover burns half as much and the old wyrm sleeps deeper after.

w_patrol.title: See the Watch at work
w_patrol.hint: Watch Houses on a road send watchmen out; the streets they walk count as watched, and they kill hounds and lay the restless they meet.

w_sexton.title: See a sexton lay the dead
w_sexton.hint: Boneyards and Ossuaries on a road send sextons out with salt; each restless they lay quiets one of the dead.

w_healer.title: A healer at the door
w_healer.hint: Healer's Shrines and Hospices send healers to the unhappiest home in reach: +4 happiness there for a day.

w_warden.title: Candles on the spires
w_warden.hint: Under the Spire Wardens edict every lit spire sends a Tallowkin warden walking spire to spire; nothing near a warden is warped by a surge.

w_scholar.title: A scholar at the delve
w_scholar.hint: A lit Academy on a road sends a scholar to the Ruin Delve; every relic piece is carried home and named by hand.

w_tamer.title: The tamer makes her rounds
w_tamer.hint: A Tamer's Lodge on a road sends a tamer to every cradle within ten tiles that holds dragons: calmer and faster-growing that day.

w_pilgrim.title: Pilgrims on the road
w_pilgrim.hint: Shrines and temples on roads send pilgrims to one another and to the Founding Stake; the roads they walk count as under faith.

u_cut.title: Cut the first hill
u_cut.hint: Stone quarried is counted from hills levelled (Land tab) and buildings standing on hills; every depth milestone needs it. Two stone opens the Cut.

u_seep.title: Cut a Seep at the hill foot
u_seep.hint: Water tab. A Seep must touch hills; it waters 6 tiles and asks no mana.

u_street.title: A street of six halls on the hill
u_street.hint: Zone hearths on hill tiles beside a road: hills are the Grimmen's best land and grass is poor.

u_ward.title: Raise a Stone Ward
u_ward.hint: Services tab at the Gallery. A standing stone holds the Gloam back 8 tiles with no mana.

u_gallery.title: Reach the Gallery
u_gallery.hint: A hundred folk and six stone quarried.

u_hatch.title: Hatch a stone line
u_hatch.hint: A Hatchery (Deep Hold) takes Bone, Grey and Ember eggs only; the bright lines are sold on to the Crown.

u_forge.title: Bind a Warden at the Forge-Temple
u_forge.hint: Deephold. A Warden that mining wakes within 20 tiles of a lit Forge-Temple climbs out already bound.

u_seat.title: Cut the Underking's Seat
u_seat.hint: Leisure tab at the Underking's Hall. The deepest hall in Eda wards 30 tiles and counts ten stone.

v_well.title: Sink a tide-well
v_well.hint: Water tab. A Tide-Well must touch river or lake water; it waters 10 tiles and asks no mana.

v_landings.title: Lay two landings
v_landings.hint: Services tab. Barges sail between landings, and every landing counts toward the next reach.

v_barge.title: Send the first barge
v_barge.hint: A barge casts off when works within 8 tiles of one landing hold goods and markets within 8 of another have room.

v_mill.title: A mill in the current
v_mill.hint: Ley tab from the Haven. A Torrent Mill on the bank makes a third more for the Veshari, and the river never freezes for them.

v_pool.title: Dig a Tide Pool
v_pool.hint: Services tab from the Haven. A Tide Pool takes Tide, Storm and Glim eggs; it must touch water and sit within 6 of a node or spire.

v_hatch.title: Hatch a water line
v_hatch.hint: A tide egg comes up in a net once a Tide Pool stands; a storm egg after a mana-storm. Keep one.

v_flood.title: Weather the first flood
v_flood.hint: From the fifth night of the Hush the Sable rises: homes on the bank lose heart unless bargemen bail them or a Great Weir stands. Come through one Hush.

v_weir.title: Raise the Great Weir
v_weir.hint: Leisure tab at Vesh's Court. The Weir makes 90 mana from the current, wards 30 tiles across the water and holds the flood.

t_spire.title: Light the first spire
t_spire.hint: Ley tab. A Tallowkin spire costs twice the Vellish price and reaches a tile farther; every window it lights counts toward the next milestone.

t_tower.title: Raise a Wick-Tower
t_tower.hint: Ley tab. A Wick-Tower lights four tiles from a lit spire or node for a quarter of the price, and sends a lamplighter down the street each day.

t_shrine.title: Set a Candle-Shrine
t_shrine.hint: Services tab. The Candle-Shrine lights itself and asks no mana; faith within 6.

t_half.title: Light half the city
t_half.hint: Twenty buildings standing and half of them lit: the Taper asks half, the Hall of Wicks nine tenths. The Mana view (1) shows the dark ones in red.

t_vigil.title: Keep the Hush vigil
t_vigil.hint: On the first night of the Hush the city is asked to keep every window lit. The Tallowkin pay half the candle-money and may not refuse; the Hall of Wicks is sworn at that vigil.

t_nexus.title: Raise a Nexus
t_nexus.hint: Ley tab from the Lantern. A Nexus relays the ley nine tiles, holds a store against the surge and carries two hundred of load.

t_hall.title: Raise the Hall of Wicks
t_hall.hint: Leisure tab from Beacon-Street, once the vigil has been kept. The Hall lights itself and nine tiles around it, relays the ley like a Nexus and sends three lamplighters out each day.

t_lantern.title: Raise the Lantern of Wicks
t_lantern.hint: Leisure tab at the Hall of Wicks milestone: nine tenths of the city lit. The Lantern wards 30 tiles and lights the street around it.

v_find.title: Find the Sleeping Wyrm
v_find.hint: One distant node is ringed with scale, not stone. Click it. Spires there would wake it.

v_tribute.title: Settle a tribute
v_tribute.hint: Awake, it asks each season: crowns or goods. Refuse and it burns.

v_court.title: Raise the Wyrm-Court
v_court.hint: Leisure tab, Free City. Needs 40 mana and a third of the folk educated for the song.

v_bind.title: Bind the wyrm
v_bind.hint: When the Court is lit the singers offer the binding. A bound wyrm wards 30 tiles and eats 40 goods a day.

v_egg.title: Keep the guardian fed for a season
v_egg.hint: Markets within reach must hold 40 goods a day. A content wyrm lays a vein egg.

z_daily.title: Daily challenge: the fifth milestone by day 60
z_daily.hint: The same valley and people for everyone today. Speed matters: zone early, light everything, keep the tithe at 10%. Day 61 is too late; the score is the days to spare and a point a thousand crowns.

z_onenode.title: The one-node valley: reach Burgh
z_onenode.hint: One Vein, running deep. Thrum Fonts, a Torrent Mill and the Nexus carry the rest.

z_island.title: The Gloam-locked island: Township and 300 tiles burned back
z_island.hint: Ward Lanterns outward from the Stake; the Watch and a Hunters' Lodge for the hounds.

z_inherited.title: The inherited collapse: ten clean days, then Burgh
z_inherited.hint: Bulldoze the ruins, lay the restless down, cut mana consumers, raise the tithe a little.

c_thorp.title: Become a Thorp (100 folk)
c_thorp.hint: Zone, light, water; keep taxes near 10%.

c_village.title: Become a Village (220 folk)
c_village.hint: Healers and a Boneyard keep folk alive and quiet.

c_market.title: Become a Market Town (650 folk)
c_market.hint: Markets need goods; carts need roads.

c_burgh.title: Become a Burgh (1000 folk)
c_burgh.hint: Watch the mana; a Nexus and Fonts carry a burgh.

c_free.title: Become a Free City (1500 folk)
c_free.hint: Deepen the Wellspring; districts and edicts keep the peace.

c_beacon.title: Become a Beacon of Eda (2200 folk)
c_beacon.hint: Raise and light the Lantern of Vell; the Crown names no Beacon without it.

c_daughter.title: Found a daughter wardlight
c_daughter.hint: Click a ley node at least 30 tiles from the Stake: a second stake, a district and a 15,000-crown grant. One treasury, one Charter.

c_twin.title: Twin Beacons: 500 folk at the daughter wardlight
c_twin.hint: Zone, light and water within 30 tiles of the daughter stake.
